description: UCL Student Union Ticket Request Form (TRF): asks the Union to put paid tickets (or a product such as kit) on sale on the SU website. The president or treasurer submits it at least 10 working days before the event (or the products' on-sale date), and only after the event has a What's On listing, because the form asks for that page's URL (and takes the event title, date, time and venue from the listing). Prerequisites the Union checks: an approved Activity Registration Form if the event spends £200/£350 or more; an approved Additional Risk Assessment for one-off or high-risk events; an approved External Speaker Request Form for an external speaker; an approved Charity Permission Letter for charity fundraising; an approved design for kit or merchandise; an approved Coach/Instructor Registration and Contract for coached sessions. Prices can differ for UCL students, concessions, members and external attendees, with optional early-bird tiers. Free tickets don't need this form: the society creates them itself on the SU website.
